cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Herbert Goldstone, New York, NY, 1958; Descended in family; (ACA Galleries, New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946." Abiquiú Notebooks and Whitney Archive indicate, "On backing: In pencil by O'Keeffe 'Small Black Iris' 36. Star initials [not verified]. Note: O'Keeffe says this is same as the Knight Pub. color plate 4. This should be checked as I had no way of comparison and the rough sketch I made of the paintings does not look the same as the color plate." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Knight Pub, 1927 Color Plate no. 4." Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert, May 1958." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: The soft, purplish inner petals of an iris surround its black center. The flower's outer petals, painted in shades of white and gray, fill the top of the composition. A gray background stretches out behind the bloom.
title: Black Iris
